mostWorthwhile.text: Making the protein brought the chapter's ideas together: food provides building material and fuel, while RNA gives an instruction.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding ribosomes was straightforward, but the result mainly showed where they sit; the more interesting explanation came later.

surprise.text: I hadn't known what ATP was when the goal appeared. Making it showed that energy from glucose is transferred into ATP for the cell to use.

arbitrary.text: Using ATP with the ribosome made sense as an energy connection, but I followed the only offered pairing without knowing exactly how ATP helps build a protein.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: seeing the separate cell parts work together was interesting, and I'd like to see how the game connects cells to larger body structures.
